semantics.address: width 1..16; row 0..15; column 0..width-1; address = row * width + column; max 255
semantics.decode: index 0..255 and index < 16 * width; row = index // width, column = index % width
semantics.phase_add: inputs 0..2; (left + right) modulo 3; cyclic phase closure only
semantics.edge_valid: count 2..256, source/target 0..255; valid iff distinct and both < count
semantics.edge_step: requires edge_valid and current/influence in 0..1; (current + influence) modulo 2; does not prove graph adjacency

input_policy: Only natural decimal inputs with documented bounds; invalid inputs rejected before SPARK precondition calls
outputs: OK:<decimal integer>, OK:<row>,<column>, or ERR:INVALID; no implicit truncation of unbounded integers
assumptions: finite rectangular addressing, not CRT bijection
edge validity means bounded distinct endpoints, not membership in an adjacency relation
phase closure is Z/3Z addition, not a quantum phase theorem
SPARK CLI I/O is outside proof scope
limitations: GNATprove must actually run and discharge contracts before ADA_CONTRACT_VERIFIED
Ada verification alone does not verify Python or JS
